name: Admin Diagnostic Bulk Actions
description: Admin selects diagnostics via row/header checkboxes in /panel/diagnostics; a batch bar appears with 'Finalizar aceptados' and 'Eliminar' (confirm modal), calling POST /api/diagnostics/bulk-action/ with {ids, action} and refreshing the list with a result notification. Covered by e2e/admin/admin-diagnostic-bulk-actions.spec.js. (Ago 2026) The selection is reconciled against the loaded diagnostics, so deleting a selected row drops it from the batch bar's count instead of leaving a record that no longer exists in it.
